title: Harshitamiddha05/WanderNest
summary: WanderNest 是一个基于 TypeScript 的 Web 端客评情感分析工具，为生态民宿运营商提供即时的人工智能情感分类、主题标签和推荐管理回应。该平台利用大型语言模型 (LLM) API 实现对客评的深度分析，适用于提升民宿服务质量。，基于模型推理的架构
description: WanderNest is a webbased guest review sentiment analysis tool built for eco-homestay operators like Trishul Eco-Homestays. The platform enables staff to paste one or multiple guest reviews and instantly receive AI-generated sentiment classification, theme tagging, and a suggested management response
